spell_materials.description: Saved material supplies associated with exact carried inventory entries. quantity counts material units and value_cp is each unit value in copper. components names exact spell component IDs (for example stoneskin.1). Declare only established supplies; casting consumes them. A focus or pouch still needs a carried item. Zero quantity retains the supply identity.

worn_armor.description: The actual worn carried item, or null when this slot is empty.

worn_shield.description: The actual worn carried item, or null when this slot is empty.

initial_state_validation.description: Supply complete spellcasting_grants for actual classes, feats and lineage, including automatic spells. Use each source's ability, spell list and own class level. Save Wizard spellbook entries and required subclasses; prepared_spells must equal the grant union. The draft checker returns missing or invalid choices before publication. Record worn_armor and worn_shield explicitly, using null for empty slots. Worn items must be carried; defenses are calculated from gear and class choices, including selected Fighting Styles and Divine/Primal Order.

abilities.description: Final ability scores after generation and all selected creation adjustments. Do not save the unadjusted standard array. Apply the selected background's required increases: +2 to one and +1 to another of its three listed abilities, or +1 to all three, without increasing any score above 20 through that choice. Read the selected background in the contained SRD Character Origins reference.

choice.description: Resolved grant or player choice; no pending placeholders.

background.description: The selected SRD background. Read its ability-score choices, feat, skill and tool proficiencies, and starting equipment before completing the character.

source.description: Class feature or exact class-level feat slot spent.

origin_feats.description: Every selected SRD Origin feat, including the background feat and any additional species-granted choice. This records the choices; it does not claim their mechanics are automated. Preserve separate selections of a repeatable feat and record its chosen benefits in the authored profile.

skill_proficiencies.description: Complete skill and tool choices source by source: class, background, species, then each Origin feat. Record each source's required number and selected proficiencies in the authored profile, then put the complete distinct skill list here. Human Skillful grants one skill; each Skilled selection grants three skill or tool proficiencies. Put tool choices in tool_proficiencies. A repeated proficiency does not fulfill another choice: select a different legal proficiency where permitted.

species.description: The selected SRD species. Read all fixed traits and choices for that species. Record granted proficiencies in their participant fields and every selected Origin feat in origin_feats; preserve fixed traits that have no declared engine field in the authored character profile. Human Skillful grants one extra skill; Human Versatile grants an Origin feat in addition to the background feat. These are separate choices.

speed.description: Base walking Speed from species, before class movement bonuses, armor, Exhaustion or temporary effects. The engine applies those separately.

trigger.description: Concrete event that earns the award.

xp_award_sources.description: Retained creature/stat-block and other award sources.

character_state.description: The same character ID, selecting its live mechanical state.

choices_summary.description: Explain all gains and choices to the player; at most 1000 characters.

armor_class.description: AC from the source or explicit GM adjudication.

cantrip_scaling_level.description: Default 1. Supply another level only when the stat block explicitly grants scaled cantrips; never substitute Challenge Rating.

charisma_save.description: Optional signed charisma saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

constitution_save.description: Optional signed constitution saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

creature_id.description: Stable unique ID for this individual creature, at most 128 letters/digits or . _ : -. Reuse it later; never use a Player Character or Companion ID.

damage_immunities.description: Copy all damage immunities from the source; an omitted list means none.

damage_resistances.description: Copy all damage resistances from the source; an omitted list means none.

damage_vulnerabilities.description: Copy all damage vulnerabilities from the source; an omitted list means none.

dexterity_save.description: Optional signed dexterity saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

equipment.description: Optional one equipment profile from the stat block or recorded GM adaptation. Record base speeds before armor, AC without worn gear (including natural defenses), Strength/Dexterity, armor training, and zero or one carried item in armor/shield. Supplied final AC and walking Speed must agree. Omit only when gear changes are not needed.

hit_points.description: Current and maximum HP for this newly introduced, unwounded creature. Never prepare an existing wounded creature again.

initiative_modifier.description: Signed Initiative modifier from the source or explicit GM adjudication.

intelligence_save.description: Optional signed intelligence saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

multiattack.description: Optional pure-attack Multiattack routine from the read stat block or explicit recorded adaptation. Each attack name is unique, at most 120 characters, and names one component with its permitted count. This does not encode spell substitutions or other non-attack effects.

size_rank.description: Size from the source or recorded adjudication: Tiny 0, Small 1, Medium 2, Large 3, Huge 4, Gargantuan 5.

skill_checks.description: Actual total NPC skill-check modifiers from the selected stat block. For an unlisted skill use its actual ability modifier. Omitted skills remain unknown; never guess them from saving throws.

source.description: 1 to 1000 characters: identify the read Plan/Setting/stat-block reference and explicitly explain any GM-adjudicated adaptation or missing statistics.

speed.description: Walking speed in feet from the source or explicit GM adjudication.

spell_component_exemptions.description: Copy only components explicitly waived by this creature stat block. Empty means normal spell components are required; do not infer a waiver from slot-free casting.

spells.description: Executable spells from the stat block. Each has its own X/day pool; 0 means at will. Omit casting_level for its lowest level. Set it only for an explicit stat-block exception; shared pools and other restrictions are not encoded by this list.

strength_save.description: Optional signed strength saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

wisdom_save.description: Optional signed wisdom saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

spellbook_available.description: For Wizard preparation, confirm the character can access and study their spellbook.

spells.description: Complete replacement list for this source, including its unchanged spells and cantrips.

attack_distance.description: Actual distance to this target in feet.

attack_modifier.description: Signed d20 attack modifier from the admitted creature stat block or GM adaptation.

attack_name.description: Plain attack label from the admitted creature stat block or the GM's stated adaptation.

damage_expression.description: Damage dice only; select one exact enum value and do not include a modifier.

damage_modifier.description: Signed flat damage modifier applied after the damage dice.

long_range.description: Maximum ranged distance; for melee use the same value as normal_range.

normal_range.description: Melee reach or normal ranged distance in feet from the stat block or stated adaptation.

target.description: Exact authoritative entity ID of the living attack target; do not use its display name.

use_multiattack.description: Use a remaining named component of the creature's prepared Multiattack; true on every attack in that routine.

attack_ability.description: Match the selected weapon. A dart uses Dexterity and a quarterstaff uses Strength. Other finesse weapons permit either, ordinary melee or thrown weapons use Strength, and ordinary ranged weapons use Dexterity.

attack_mode.description: Match the selected weapon's legal use. A dart uses thrown, never melee; a quarterstaff uses melee. Use ranged only for a ranged weapon that is not being thrown.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

weapon.description: Choose only a weapon established in the active actor's authoritative inventory. Use the canonical singular weapon ID; an inventory entry of darts authorizes dart.

wielding_two_handed.description: State the selected weapon's actual use. For a dart this must be false. A quarterstaff may be true for its versatile two-handed damage or false for one-handed use.
